named-query.name: Pesquisador.listarPesquisadorPorBolsa
named-query.query: SELECT p FROM Pesquisador p WHERE p.valorDiarioBolsa > ( SELECT AVG(p2.valorDiarioBolsa) FROM Pesquisador p2 )

named-query.name: Expedicao.listarResumoPorPeriodoESituacao
named-query.query: SELECT new br.edu.ifpb.caveresearch.repository.dto.ExpedicaoResumo( e.idExpedicao, e.codigo, e.titulo, c.nomeOficial, e.inicioPrevisto, e.terminoPrevisto, e.situacao ) FROM Expedicao e JOIN e.caverna c WHERE e.inicioPrevisto < :termino AND e.terminoPrevisto >= :inicio AND e.situacao = :situacao ORDER BY e.inicioPrevisto

named-query.name: Expedicao.carregarDetalhesComParticipantes
named-query.query: SELECT DISTINCT e FROM Expedicao e JOIN FETCH e.caverna LEFT JOIN FETCH e.participacoes p LEFT JOIN FETCH p.pessoa WHERE e.idExpedicao = :idExpedicao
